ns2:course.label: Literacy in Content Areas
ns2:course.description: Provides secondary and K-12 level education majors with principles and practices of effective language and literacy instruction in their content areas, consistent with the Core Language Arts and Content Standards of the Illinois State Board of Education. Prerequisite: Admission to a teacher education program.
ns2:course.sectionCappArea: Restricted to Second School Teaching or Admitted Teacher Ed Student students.
